author: Vertyco
description: A bare-bones two-player ActivityHub game to copy when starting a new one. Two players each move a dot around a shared field, anyone else in the Activity watches, and every file explains itself in comments. Its README walks through each piece. Needs ActivityHub 0.10.0 or later.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no data about users.
install_msg:
Thank you for installing Activity Cookiecutter!

Activity Cookiecutter is a game for ActivityHub, which must be installed and set up first:
`[p]repo add vrt-cogs https://github.com/vertyco/vrt-cogs`
`[p]cog install vrt-cogs activityhub`
`[p]load activityhub`
Then follow ActivityHub's README: https://github.com/vertyco/vrt-cogs/blob/main/activityhub/README.md

Once both are loaded, Activity Cookiecutter shows up in the hub's menu.
short: A bare two-player ActivityHub game to copy
